description: Real-pilot recalibration (asr-gate calibrate) on pilot_results_2026-07-09/cal20_scored.jsonl (7,142 scored utterances, n_cal=3567 after speaker auto-split + 1 dropped missing-s1 utt, macro-CER approx 0.0163), comparing the OLD default LTT path (procedure=fixed-sequence, p_value=hb -- the exact combination that produced the pilot failure: certified nothing at alpha=0.02) against the NEW default path (procedure=bonferroni, p_value=eb) at alpha=0.02 and alpha=0.03, delta=0.1, seed=0. Produced for verification only; does not modify any existing pilot artifact (gate.json etc.).
